stages.name: Preserve anchor frame
operations: Retain the three N atoms and one B atom in task order.
Fix all four anchor coordinates exactly as supplied.

stages.name: Build fused MR-TADF core
operations: Add the central and flanking six-membered aromatic rings.
Close the N-containing five/six-membered rings and the three-coordinate B ring system.

stages.name: Add peripheral fragments
operations: Attach two phenyl substituents to the left-center donor.
Attach four tert-butyl substituents at the image-indicated aryl positions.
Close the right lower acridane ring through a tetrahedral carbon and add the spiro fluorene.

stages.name: Generate 3D candidate
operations: Initialize from image geometry with orthogonal spiro planes.
Run UFF relaxation with all B/N anchors fixed and restore exact anchor decimals.

notes: The edit schema has no atom-level command vocabulary, so this plan records structured high-level stages. Aromatic bond placement follows the visible Kekule rings.
